8 days Golden Triangle tour with Udaipur

Delhi · Agra · Jaipur · Udaipur · 8 days

8 days Golden Triangle tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

Delhi, Agra and Jaipur at a steady pace, then Udaipur's lakes and palaces to finish, with the flight home from there.

What makes this one worth it

  • Old and New Delhi with a rickshaw ride through Chandni Chowk
  • Taj Mahal at sunrise, Agra Fort and the Baby Taj
  • Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, City Palace and Jantar Mantar in Jaipur
  • Boat ride on Lake Pichola past the Taj Lake Palace and Jag Mandir
  • Udaipur to Delhi by flight, so no long drive back

Your day by day

  1. Day 1

    Arrive in Delhi

    Arrive in Delhi, private transfer to your hotel, check in and relax.

  2. Day 2

    Old and New Delhi with your guide

    Pickup at 9 am for Jama Masjid, a rickshaw ride through Chandni Chowk, the spice market and the Red Fort from outside. Then Humayun's Tomb, India Gate, Parliament House, Qutub Minar and the Lotus Temple.

  3. Day 3

    To Agra, the Baby Taj and Mehtab Bagh

    Checkout at 10 am, drive to Agra. Itimad-ud-Daulah, then sunset at Mehtab Bagh.

  4. Day 4

    Sunrise Taj Mahal and on to Jaipur

    Taj Mahal at sunrise, breakfast and checkout, Agra Fort, then on to Jaipur stopping at Fatehpur Sikri.

  5. Day 5

    Jaipur forts, palaces and Patrika Gate

    Amber Fort, a photo stop at Jal Mahal, Hawa Mahal, City Palace, Jantar Mantar and Patrika Gate.

  6. Day 6

    The scenic drive to Udaipur

    A scenic six-hour drive to Udaipur through the Rajasthan countryside, then check in and relax.

  7. Day 7

    Udaipur, the City Palace and Lake Pichola

    Jagdish Temple and the City Palace, a boat ride on Lake Pichola, then Fateh Sagar Lake, Saheliyon Ki Bari and Bagore Ki Haveli.

  8. Day 8

    Departure from Udaipur

    Breakfast, checkout and transfer to Udaipur airport for your flight to Delhi or onward.

Questions people ask

When is the best time to go?
October to March, when the weather suits long days at forts and palaces and Udaipur's lakes are at their best.
Is the Lake Pichola boat ride included?
It depends on the package you select. It can be added on request.
Can this work as a honeymoon trip?
Yes, and it often does. Upgraded rooms, a private boat and a romantic dinner can all be arranged.
Can we change the itinerary?
Yes. Hotel category, sightseeing time and extra stops are all adjustable before you confirm.
